title: Spying on the Scammers [Part 1/5]
summary: Jim Browning reverses a scammer's remote connection and discovers CCTV in a Delhi call centre. He gives a detailed look at how a tech support scam operation runs, and he shared the footage with the BBC.
why: HN points to it as a fascinating inside look at how Indian scam call centres operate, often when scams come up in discussion.

quote.text: This is a fascinating YouTube series from a guy who managed to hack into the IT system of an Indian scam operation
